segments.text:
V. 37.
Fourſcore and four years—Theſe were the Years of her Life, not her Widowhood only. Who departed not from the temple—Who attended there at all the ſtated Hours of Prayer. But ſerved God with faſtings and prayers—Even at that Age. Night and day—That is, ſpending therein a conſiderable Part of the Night, as well as of the Day.
